turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: When should I plant tulip bulbs?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: In autumn, once the soil has cooled down. Late October to November is usually ideal.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: About three times the height of the bulb, so roughly fifteen to twenty centimeters, pointy end up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And can I put them in pots? I was hoping to

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: put a few by the front door.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, tulips look great in pots. Pack them closely together and make sure the pot drains well.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, can you say that again?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Yes, tulips look great in pots. Pack them closely together and make sure the pot drains well.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do they come back every year?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Some do, but many fade after the first year. Lots of people just plant fresh ones each autumn.
